steps.title: Empty root
steps.desc: profile-boot.ts writes a fresh empty entry list; the whole tree patches over [].

steps.title: Bundle layers
steps.desc: dsh-base inserts its rows first; the mode bundle (web-app / headless) stacks over it.

steps.title: Profile patch
steps.desc: The profile's own cordis.patch.yml overrides or inserts rows by id.

steps.title: Home patch
steps.desc: $DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml outranks the profile file with machine-local preferences.

steps.title: Patch overlays
steps.desc: --patch overlay(s) apply last, in argv order, on top of every file layer.

steps.title: Composed tree
steps.desc: composeEntries yields the final tree — exactly what --dump-config prints.
